messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — final on-site loop for Backend Eng (4 rounds) is set for Wed 2026-10-18. Need cover asks and a debrief owner.
Samir: I'm on the calendar for system design + coding, 11:00 AM PT. Who's owning the debrief consolidation?
Maya: @Devon can you take debrief? If not, I can but prefer a central owner.
Devon: I can do the consolidation. Need a scribe for the coding round and candidate transcript consent captured.
Elena: I can scribe for the coding round (round 2). Will take notes and paste into the debrief doc.
Jordan: Quick rubric Q — are we using default weights (technical 50 / design 30 / collaboration 20) or moving to equal-weight for this role? Last on-site had inconsistent scoring.
Maya: Ops guideline: default weights are 50/30/20 for IC3. We only bump design for IC4+. This candidate is IC3 so use default. I'll paste the anchor doc.
Jordan: Appreciate the anchor. Can you share the link?
Maya: https://docs.internal/recruiting/rubrics/backend-onsite — includes anchor examples for each band and sample phrasing for scores.
Jordan: Thanks. Two more small asks: 1) please remind interviewers to keep explicit decision anchors (what would be a hire vs no-hire) in the comment. 2) post-code feedback in the debrief doc within 24h.
Samir: +1 on the 24h rule. Also, candidate timezone is CET; calendar shows 11:00 AM PT which is 8:00 PM CET. Candidate confirmed they're okay with that.
Elena: Noted. Can people ensure Zoom links include "recording consent" line? I asked candidate yesterday and they agreed to allow notes but not recording.
Maya: Good catch — candidate consent: notes only, no recording. Scribe please capture that at the top of the debrief doc.
Devon: I'll add a consent header and the scribe label. Also setting a People-ops reminder to nudge interviewers after the session.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: debrief due 24h after last interview. Link: https://docs.internal/recruiting/debriefs/2026-10-18-backend-T
Maya: Calendar invite needs a small edit — add "30-min buffer for take-home review" in the description. Here's the snippet to paste into the invite body:
```
Please allow a 30-minute buffer after the candidate's take-home review for interviewer prep and notes. Candidate timezone: CET (no recording consent).
```
Jordan: Also — for the coding round, use the new scoring anchors:
- 0-2: major gaps (doesn't meet bar)
- 3: borderline
- 4-5: meets/exceeds (with examples)
I'll drop a short example comment in the rubric doc.
Elena: Quick logistics: who will be the backup if someone drops within 6 hours?
Maya: If someone drops, flag here and @people-ops-bot will try to find a last-minute cover; otherwise we reschedule candidate. Try to avoid reschedules.
Samir: I'll be standby if needed.
Devon: I'll own consolidation and run the sync next Mon 10/19 to review evals.
Jordan: Thanks all — tagging interviewers: @Elena @Samir @Devon — please ack when you see this.
Elena: ack
Samir: ack
Devon: ack
Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
